name: Luchtar

attributes.attribute: brother of the smith god Goibniu
made spear shafts for the Tuatha De Danann

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Luchtar, also written Luchta, was an Irish god of craftsmanship. He was one of the lesser gods of skill in the old tales. Luchtar was the brother of the smith god Goibniu. He ruled over carpentry and made the spear shafts for the Tuatha De Danann. Those shafts served the gods in their fight against the monstrous Fomorians at the second battle of Mag Tuired.

okr.objective: Document the Irish craftsman god Luchtar and his role among the gods.
